cases.title: Add forward curve validation
cases.body:
Curves arrive from an upstream feed and are occasionally malformed; today a bad curve only surfaces as a confusing MTM error mid-calculation.

## Acceptance criteria

- New exported function `validateCurve(curve)` in `src/pricing.ts` returning `string[]` of problems (empty when valid).
- Flags negative prices (message names the commodity and month) and month keys not matching `YYYY-MM`.
- Pure validation: no throwing, no changes to `markToMarket` or `portfolioMtm` behaviour.
- Tests cover: a valid curve, a negative price, a malformed month key, and multiple problems reported together.

cases.title: Trade validation accepts zero-length delivery windows
cases.body:
`validateTrade` in `src/validation.ts` accepts `deliveryStart` equal to `deliveryEnd`. Ops treats these as booking errors: a delivery window must cover at least one full day.

## Expected behaviour

A trade with `deliveryEnd` equal to `deliveryStart` is invalid.

## Acceptance criteria

- `validateTrade` reports an error (message mentioning the delivery window) when `deliveryEnd` equals `deliveryStart`; windows where end is after start remain valid.
- The existing end-before-start rule is unchanged.
- Tests cover the equal-dates rejection and a one-day window acceptance.

cases.title: Add a trade count to the trade book
cases.body:
Reporting needs a cheap way to know how many trades are in the book without materialising the full list.

## Acceptance criteria

- New method `TradeBook.count()` returning the number of captured trades.
- No other new methods, no changes to existing behaviour — reporting/aggregation beyond the count is explicitly out of scope.
- Tests cover an empty book and a book with several trades.

cases.title: Improve the library
cases.body: The library should be faster and more robust. Can we make it better overall?

cases.title: Add trade amendment support
cases.body: Traders sometimes need to amend a trade after capture. We should support amending trades somehow — maybe versioning them, or edit-in-place? Not sure what fields should be amendable or how positions should treat amended trades. Open to proposals.

cases.title: Fix rounding in the settlement engine
cases.body: Settlement amounts are rounding incorrectly for GAS trades — we are seeing cent-level discrepancies in the settlement engine output. Please fix the rounding mode.
